title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Implemented numerical integration for PME traveling-wave ODE in code/solve_traveling_wave.py using solve_ivp (RK45) with event termination at the saturation front. Generated solution arrays (outputs/solution.npz), diagnostics with quantitative residual norms for r1=(f^m)'+cf and r2=(f^m)''+cf' (outputs/metrics.json), and mandatory figures (report/images/*.png). Wrote publication-style report with model, method settings, and residual-based verification in report/report.md.
